A young swimmer receives a special award.

Chinese swimmer Yu Zidi has received a special award at the Asian Games in Japan. She was named the most valuable female athlete on Sunday. At thirteen, she became the youngest person to receive this award in the history of the Games.

Yu won three individual gold medals. She also set three Asian Games records and one Asian record. Her winning races included the two-hundred-meter butterfly and two events in which swimmers use different swimming styles. These results made her one of the young stars of the competition.

At the award ceremony, Yu said the honor encouraged young athletes. The award ceremony took place in Nagoya, one of the cities hosting the Games. Her story connects strong results in the pool with the chance to develop as a young sportsperson. The award recognizes what she achieved during the Games.
